ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore and share content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Used to create #anchor-links on the page. Use only letters, numbers, and hyphens.

SectionTitle.helper: Required. Main section heading. Formatted text and links are allowed and will render in the view.
SectionTitle.placeholder: A Calm Start to This Section

SectionTitleCssClass.helper: Optional. Extra classes applied to the section title.

SectionTitleIcon.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

SectionIntroText.helper: Required. Introductory content shown below the title. Basic formatting and links are supported.
SectionIntroText.placeholder: Add a short introduction for this section.

SectionTextCssClass.helper: Optional. Extra classes applied to the intro text.

SectionIcon.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.
